# BreezingForms NG

> BreezingForms NG (com_breezingformsng) is a free, GPL form builder for Joomla 6 and PHP 8.4+.
> It is the community-maintained continuation of Crosstec BreezingForms: visual QuickMode editor,
> multi-page forms, visibility rules, file uploads, signatures, captcha/reCAPTCHA, email
> notifications, submission records with PDF/CSV/XLSX/XML export, Stripe/PayPal payments,
> per-form PHP and JavaScript hooks, GDPR privacy plugin, and 8 languages.

Install from the GitHub releases through Joomla's extension installer. Embed a form with a menu
item, the `mod_breezingformsng` module or the content plugin `{BreezingForms:FormName}`.
Existing BreezingForms (Crosstec) sites upgrade in place: data stays in the `#__facileforms_*` tables.

Historical lineage: BreezingForms NG continues FacileForms, credited to Peter Koch in historical
2004–2006 copyright headers, followed by BreezingForms under Markus Bopp/Crosstec from around
2008. Community-led BreezingForms NG modernization began in 2024. The exact first public release
date is not established; Joomla forum records document FacileForms in public use by August–September
2005. See the [README history](https://github.com/vcmb-cyclo/com_breezingformsng/blob/main/README.md#historical-lineage)
for sources and the distinction between copyright evidence and first distribution.

- [Upgrading from BreezingForms](https://github.com/vcmb-cyclo/com_breezingformsng/blob/main/skills/breezingformsng/references/migration.md): what the installer migrates, what to check
